STEP 7. Check for open circuit and harness damage 
between volume air flow sensor connector B-14 terminal 7 
and ECM connector C-51 terminal 19 <M/T> or PCM 
connector C-52 terminal 19 <A/T>.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Replace the ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 9.
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 9.
STEP 8. Replace the volume air flow sensor.
(1) Replace the volume air flow sensor.
(2) Carry out a test drive with the drive cycle pattern. Refer to 
P.13B-4, Procedure 6 − Other Monitor.
(3) Check the diagnostic trouble code (DTC).
Q: Is the DTC P0103 is output?
YES : Replace the ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 9.
NO : The inspection is complete.
STEP 9. Test the OBD-II drive cycle.
(1) Carry out a test drive with the drive cycle pattern. Refer to 
P.13B-4, Procedure 6 − Other Monitor.
(2) Check the diagnostic trouble code (DTC).
Q: Is the DTC P0103 is output?
YES : Retry the troubleshooting.
NO : The inspection is complete.
